ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Cases on the Rise
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Woodhaven mayor and HS hockey coach
ideas.angle: Follow the money and analyze patterns of corruption
questions: What are the common factors among these cases?
How can we prevent similar cases in the future?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and mismanagement in Minnesota

ideas.title: Kash Patel Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations against FBI Director Kash Patel and the lawsuit against The Atlantic
ideas.angle: Analyze the facts and potential implications for Patel's career
questions: What are the specific allegations against Patel?
How will this affect his role as FBI Director?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the accountability of high-ranking officials
